asleep.text: (Fast asleep. Best not to wake them.)
asleep.speaker: narrator

bridge.text: When will it reopen? Ha. When the masons come, and the masons come when the money comes, and the money comes from somewhere east of a bridge that isn't there. You see the difficulty.

choices.text: So the road east is closed.

bridge2.text: For now. They'll fix it. Someone always does, in the end. Until then, Brindlecross is as far east as anyone goes.

main.text: Bridge is out. Has been since the melt.

cross.text: Not unless you've wings or a death wish. There's a ladder down by the old stub, if you fall in. People fall in.
